name: Exp_Trigger_Line
summary: This EA trades based on the Trigger Line indicator, which is a variation of the Linear Regression Channel or moving average crossover system. It opens buy positions when the fast trigger line crosses above the slow trigger line and sell positions on the reverse crossover, implementing a systematic trend-following strategy with configurable lot sizing and stop levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于触发线(Trigger Line)指标进行交易，这是一种线性回归通道或均线交叉系统的变体。当快速触发线上穿慢速触发线时开多仓，反之开空仓，实现了可配置手数和止损水平的系统化趋势跟踪策略。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用双触发线交叉策略作为核心入场逻辑，属于典型的趋势跟踪系统。快速触发线与慢速触发线的金叉作为做多信号，死叉作为做空信号，本质上捕捉的是趋势的启动和转向。出场条件依赖于反向交叉信号或预设的止损止盈水平，部分版本可能包含追踪止损机制以保护浮动利润。仓位管理采用固定手数模式，未发现基于账户余额或风险的动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面缺乏复合头寸控制，未观察到马丁格尔或网格加仓逻辑。整体策略逻辑简单清晰，但在震荡行情中可能频繁产生虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The EA employs a dual trigger line crossover strategy as its core entry logic, representing a classic trend-following system. The golden cross of the fast trigger line above the slow trigger line serves as the buy signal, while the death cross provides the sell signal, essentially capturing trend initiation and reversal. Exit conditions rely on reverse crossover signals or preset stop-loss and take-profit levels, with some versions potentially including a trailing stop mechanism to protect floating profits. Position sizing follows a fixed lot model, with no dynamic position adjustment based on account balance or risk percentage observed. Money management lacks compound position control, and no martingale or grid pyramiding logic is present. The overall strategy logic is simple and clear, but may generate frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses.

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和调优，适合初学者使用
采用趋势跟踪方法，在明确趋势行情中能获得较好的收益
无马丁格尔或网格加仓逻辑，不存在指数级放大的爆仓风险
参数可配置性强，用户可根据不同品种和市场环境灵活调整
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic that is easy to understand and tune, suitable for beginners
Trend-following approach can capture significant profits during strong trending markets
No martingale or grid pyramiding logic, eliminating exponentially increasing risk of account blow-up
Highly configurable parameters allow users to adapt to different instruments and market conditions
cons: 在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损
固定手数仓位管理未考虑账户资金比例，缺乏风险自适应能力
缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
未包含点差过滤机制，在高点差环境下交易成本可能侵蚀利润
cons_en: Prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging or choppy markets
Fixed lot position sizing does not consider account equity ratio, lacking risk-adaptive capability
Missing new bar check mechanism may cause repeated position opening on the same bar
No spread filter included, trading costs in high-spread environments may erode profits
improvements: 增加ATR或波动率自适应止损机制，替代固定点数止损以适应不同市场波动
加入趋势强度过滤（如ADX）或震荡识别机制，避免在横盘行情中频繁交易
improvements_en: Add ATR-based or volatility-adaptive stop-loss mechanism to replace fixed pip stops for better adaptation to varying market volatility
Incorporate trend strength filtering (e.g., ADX) or range identification logic to avoid frequent trading during sideways markets

risk_points: 缺少新K线检查可能导致同根K线多次重复开仓，增加风险敞口
固定止损未考虑市场波动性变化，在剧烈波动时可能被轻易扫损
震荡行情中连续虚假信号可能造成累积亏损
risk_points_en: Missing new bar check may cause multiple position openings on the same bar, increasing risk exposure
Fixed stop-loss does not account for market volatility changes and may be easily stopped out during volatile periods
Consecutive false signals in ranging markets may result in cumulative losses
